name: Thai Smile Palm Springs
description: Signature menu, wall card recipes and off-menu builds

drinks.name: Mango Sticky Rice
drinks.base: 2oz Han rice vodka, 1oz Cruzan Coco rum
drinks.prep: Shake and strain into a chilled martini glass.
drinks.notes: Laminated recipe binder item (Menu card), but unlike the other Menu card drinks it has no price and does not appear on the printed signature menu — treated as tier 2 for drilling priority rather than tier 1 or Wall.

drinks.name: Bangkok Blues
drinks.prep: Muddle blueberries, shake and strain into a chilled, half sugar-rimmed martini glass.

drinks.name: Ginger Lemon Drop
ingredients: muddle 2 to 3 ginger pieces and 1 lemon
drinks.prep: Muddle ginger and lemon, shake and strain into a chilled, sugar-rimmed martini glass.

drinks.name: The Kiss
drinks.prep: Shake and strain into a chilled martini glass.
drinks.verify: Recipe card lists no garnish; the printed menu also lists fresh raspberries as a garnish. Confirm with the bar before garnishing.

drinks.name: Lychee Martini
drinks.prep: not documented
drinks.verify: No recipe card on file — only the printed menu documents this drink. Pour counts, rim, and exact prep are not documented. Ask the bar for the exact build.

drinks.name: Hibiscus Spritz

drinks.name: Hawaiian

drinks.name: My Thai Smile
drinks.base: 2oz Bacardi Gold rum, 2oz Bacardi Silver rum
drinks.prep: Build the two Bacardi rums in a hurricane glass over ice. Add pineapple and orange juice, stir. Add amaretto grenadine mix, then float dark rum on top.
drinks.verify: Biggest conflict on the menu: the recipe card floats Cutwater Tiki dark rum, but the printed menu says Myers's dark rum. The printed menu also lists peach schnapps and Domaine de Canton ginger liqueur, which only appear on a handwritten sticker (1oz Canton Ginger, 1oz DeKuyper Peach) — not on the laminated card. Confirm the current build with the bar before making this drink.

drinks.name: Spicy Mango
drinks.prep: Blended.
drinks.verify: No recipe card on file — only the printed menu documents this drink. Pour counts and blend ratio are not documented; glassware is also unconfirmed (likely hurricane, per the study guide, but not verified). Get exact specs from the bar.

drinks.name: Lotus Blossom
drinks.prep: Shareable format, floats of Black Raspberry liqueur and Gosling Black Strap 151 added on top.
drinks.verify: No recipe card on file — only the printed menu documents this drink. This is the most expensive item on the menu; pour counts and the shareable vessel are not documented. Get the exact build and vessel from the bar before serving.

drinks.name: Lemongrass

drinks.name: Island
drinks.base: 1 1/2oz Skrewball peanut butter whiskey, 3/4oz coco rum
drinks.prep: Shake, pour into hurricane glass.

drinks.name: Jasmine Sling

drinks.verify: Recipe card says iced tea; the printed menu specifies jasmine tea. Confirm which tea is current before building.

drinks.name: Ginger Bee
drinks.glass: rocks glass or martini glass — guest's choice, always ask
drinks.prep: Muddle mint, dry shake with honey and lemon juice, add Canton Ginger, then shake with ice. Serve on the rocks or up in a martini glass per the guest's choice.
drinks.verify: Sold both ways (rocks or up) at the same price — always ask the guest whether they want it on the rocks or up.
